passages.question: What city B&O rates apply in 2026?
passages.excerpt: Tax Classifications & Rates 2026-2032 ... Wholesaling .00342 Retail Sales & Retail Services .00342 Service & Other Business Activities .00658

passages.question: Which classification do the prime contracts and the subcontract go under?
passages.excerpt: Report revenue under Retail Services if you perform services on tangible products. ... Examples of retail services: Repair or installation of tangible products auto repair car washes catering construction ... Report revenue under Wholesaling if you sell products or services to another person or business who intends to resell your product or service to a consumer.
